must_have_properties: Every forward frame shall consist of 1 start bit + 1 address byte (YAAAAAAB, MSB first) + 1 data byte (MSB first) + 2 stop bits.
Every backward frame shall consist of 1 start bit + 1 data byte (MSB first) + 2 stop bits.
All bits shall be Manchester-encoded at 1200 baud (TE = 416.67 μs, bit time 833.33 μs).
Logic '1' = LOW-to-HIGH mid-bit transition; logic '0' = HIGH-to-LOW mid-bit transition.
The DALI bus shall be polarity-insensitive at receivers.
Bus voltage shall be in the range 9.5..22.5 V DC (IEC) — the TI SLAA422A report cites 11.5..22.5 V per the standard.
Bus current shall not exceed 250 mA.

Direct arc-power level shall follow a logarithmic dimming curve: level 0 = OFF, levels 1..254 = 0.1%..100% illumination with a constant 2.8% step between adjacent levels, level 255 = MASK (no change).
Minimum Level shall be ≥ PHYS_MIN_LEVEL of the gear (90 in the TI red/green LED example).
Maximum Level shall be ≤ 254.
Backward frame shall start between 7×TE (2.92 ms) and 22×TE (9.17 ms) after the end of the matching forward frame.
Next forward frame shall not be transmitted sooner than 22×TE (9.17 ms) after the end of the previous forward frame; IEC-recommended inter-frame settling time is 13.5 ms.

Destructive commands (RESET 0x20, STORE DTR AS SHORT ADDRESS 0x80, STORE DTR AS SCENE 0..15, STORE DTR AS MAX/MIN/SYSTEM_FAILURE/POWER_ON/FADE_TIME/FADE_RATE 0x2A..0x2F) shall be sent twice within 100 ms to commit.
Address byte Y=1 + AAAAAA=111111 shall be Broadcast — every gear receives.
Special-command address bytes 0xA1..0xCF identify a Special Command per Table 5 of SLAA422A.

Persistent variables (Power On Level, System Failure Level, Min/Max Level, Fade Rate/Time, Short Address, Group 0..7 + 8..15, Scene 0..15, Random Address, Fast Fade Time, Failure Status, Operating Mode, Dimming Curve) shall survive a bus power cycle.
Upon power-up the control gear shall apply Power On Level within 600 ms if no DALI command is received first.
Upon detection of system failure (bus voltage lost) the control gear shall apply System Failure Level.
Configuration Mode shall auto-exit after 15 minutes if no TERMINATE is received.
RANDOMIZE shall regenerate the 24-bit Random Address.
COMPARE shall cause every Configuration-Mode gear with Random Address ≤ Search Address to answer the backward-frame 'YES' code 0xFF.
WITHDRAW shall cause the gear with Random Address == Search Address to drop out of the addressing iteration.
QUERY STATUS (0x90) shall return an 8-bit status byte covering gear status, lamp failure, lamp on, limit error, fade running, reset state, missing short address, and power failure.
must_not_have_properties: There shall be NO NACK / negative-acknowledge frame. Malformed or out-of-window forward frames shall be silently discarded.
Broadcast queries shall NOT be transmitted by the control device — multiple gear answering simultaneously would collide on the bus.
The control gear shall NOT transmit a backward frame in response to a non-query forward frame.
The control gear shall NOT transmit a backward frame outside the 7..22 TE window.
The control gear shall NOT commit a destructive command on a single delivery — both deliveries of the two-strike sequence must arrive within 100 ms.
Minimum Level shall NOT be set below PHYS_MIN_LEVEL.
Maximum Level shall NOT be set above 254.
Level 255 in a direct arc-power command shall NOT change Actual Level — it is the MASK value.
An un-addressed gear shall NOT respond to a query.
Two control devices shall NOT initiate forward frames concurrently — DALI is single-master per bus.

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Bit-cell sample does not match expected level → silent discard.
Line not HIGH for ≥ 2 × bit-time after data byte → silent discard.
Forward frame arrives sooner than 9.17 ms after previous → silent discard.
Two gear answer same query (faulty broadcast) → wired-AND on the bus corrupts the response.
VBus < 9.5 V → control gear enters System Failure state.
Lamp open / short / change-in-load → QUERY LAMP FAILURE 0x92 returns 0xFF; QUERY STATUS bit 1 = 1.
Requested level outside [Minimum Level, Maximum Level] → QUERY LIMIT ERROR 0x94 returns 0xFF; level clamped.
Short Address = 0xFF → QUERY MISSING SHORT ADDRESS 0x96 returns 0xFF; QUERY STATUS bit 6 = 1.
Single delivery of destructive command → silently ignored.
15 minutes elapsed since INITIALIZE without TERMINATE → gear leaves Configuration Mode.

dali_bus.max_devices: 64 short addresses + 16 group addresses + broadcast per bus universe
dali_bus.isolation: Opto-isolation between bus and microcontroller (4N137-class typical)
dali_bus.topology: Single 2-wire bus; max cable length ~ 300 m; gauge 0.5..1.5 mm²

fields.reset_behavior_compliance: Upon hardware reset the control gear shall: (1) load persistent variables from non-volatile storage, (2) configure DALI_RX edge interrupt + PWM peripheral + WDT+ interval, (3) set Actual Level := Power On Level within 600 ms if no command arrives. After RESET special command (0x20) the gear shall return all persistent variables to their factory defaults (the command requires the two-strike commit).
